purpose: Physics specialization of the universal family-bank architecture.
rules: No fixed I Can count. Use every exact current Unit I Can from the current Assessment Plan / declared Unit learning map.
Conceptual before computational; equations are physical relationships, not answer machines.
Use physical situations when context is needed; do not manufacture irrelevant measurements.
Representation-required families must render the representation students actually use.
Simple answer-neutral vector/FBD diagrams may be embedded as accessible inline SVG; coordinate/data graphs still use the registered graph tool when applicable.
A/B/C must be materially different evidence routes, not noun or number swaps.
The canonical Bank stores family architecture plus one exemplar per family, not permanent WTC, Notes Example/YTI, Practice, CYU, Warm-Up, Quick Check, or Summative inventories.
Human-facing learning labels always show canonical I Can code plus the full exact I Can statement.
Student Bank family anchors are stable public practice destinations for Portfolio routing.
